title: The verification API answers a server error, so nothing reaches the provider
question: Users say they tap Send verification code, see an error or a spinner, and nothing arrives. The delivery logs show no failures. What is happening?

api.error_message: The server could not store the request (mock wording)

expected.notes: Provider logs show fewer requests and no new failures. The approved test call to the verification API returns a server error with a message that the request could not be stored, so those requests never reach the provider. The reason the save fails is only in the API server's own log; the report must say so and ask engineering for the inner exception. The report must not blame the provider.
